knowledge.name: Subscription Agreement Snapshot
knowledge.detail: Synthetic plans, ARR, seats, renewal dates, ownership, and agreement context used only for read-only planning.

knowledge.name: Product Adoption Evidence
knowledge.detail: Approved entitlement and telemetry evidence for seat utilization, feature adoption, and usage trends without source-system writes.

knowledge.name: Customer Health and Support Signals
knowledge.detail: Health scores, NPS, ticket volume, stakeholder changes, demand signals, and churn indicators from the fixed snapshot.

knowledge.name: Commercial Planning Assumptions
knowledge.detail: Synthetic pricing, packaging, switching-cost, and scenario assumptions labeled for review rather than quotation or commitment.

intelligence_processing.name: Renewal Pipeline Assessment
intelligence_processing.detail: Orders renewal timing, health, ownership, ARR, and risk bands, then prepares a bounded internal review checklist.

intelligence_processing.name: Expansion Signal Analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Connects utilization and stated demand to draft package options while reserving pricing and concessions for authorized review.

intelligence_processing.name: Churn and Competitive Risk
intelligence_processing.detail: Explains usage, support, sponsor, budget, and competitor signals with clearly identified switching-cost assumptions.

intelligence_processing.name: Revenue Scenario Modeling
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares synthetic renewal, expansion, and churn cases as planning scenarios, never as forecasts or revenue commitments.

clients_user_interface.name: Seller and CSM Copilot Workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Natural-language access for account executives, customer-success managers, and sales leaders across four bounded operations.

clients_user_interface.name: Account-Team Review Brief
clients_user_interface.detail: Evidence-first summaries and draft options prepared for account-team review before negotiation or customer-facing use.

clients_user_interface.name: Teams Review Handoff
clients_user_interface.detail: Supports internal Microsoft Teams collaboration while prohibiting automated messages, meetings, tasks, alerts, or outreach.

management_reporting.name: Renewal Portfolio Dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes renewal ARR, dates, health bands, ownership, and at-risk value using fixed synthetic evidence.

management_reporting.name: Risk and Expansion Summary
management_reporting.detail: Ranks churn evidence and expansion potential while separating recorded signals from calculations and assumptions.

management_reporting.name: Approval and Evidence Trace
management_reporting.detail: Records sources, assumptions, review gates, and the no-action boundary for pricing, legal, finance, and sales reviewers.

tools.name: LicenseRenewalExpansionAgent
tools.detail: Portable deterministic tool for renewal_pipeline, expansion_opportunities, churn_risk, and revenue_impact.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Conversational workspace that routes supported intents and presents evidence-first, human-governed planning results.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
tools.detail: Production seam for approved read-only account and renewal context; CRM creation, updates, and forecast mutation stay disabled.

tools.name: Subscription and Entitlement System
tools.detail: Approved production source for contract, license, plan, seat, and entitlement facts when replacing the synthetic route.

tools.name: Approved Product Telemetry
tools.detail: Governed read-only source for adoption and usage signals, with no monitoring activation or product-state changes.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Internal review channel for account and commercial teams; the agent does not send messages or schedule meetings.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic Evidence Boundary
supporting_features.detail: Labels exact customers, dates, ARR, prices, scores, percentages, and projections as synthetic planning evidence.

supporting_features.name: Account-Team Review Gate
supporting_features.detail: Requires account and customer-success owners to validate evidence and engagement plans before any external use.

supporting_features.name: No-Outreach Control
supporting_features.detail: Produces internal drafts only and never emails, messages, calls, schedules, or otherwise contacts a customer.

supporting_features.name: Commercial Mutation Guardrail
supporting_features.detail: Prevents renewal execution, quote or proposal creation, pricing changes, forecast edits, and CRM mutation.

supporting_features.name: Authorized Approval Workflow
supporting_features.detail: Reserves terms and customer materials for finance, pricing, legal, procurement, security, privacy, and sales approval.
